oracle_contract.price_oracle: Gaussian power-series integration using 110-digit Decimal working precision, independent of model erfc; tails beyond |z|14 omitted with normal tail <8e-45, giving far sub-tolerance price error over the bounded input domain. This is not a promise of 110 correct final digits.
oracle_contract.second_price_oracle: 24-point Gauss-Legendre rules with 8 and16 panels applied directly to positive lognormal payoff integrals, separately split at the strike; standardized-normal cutoff12 and bounded volatility-horizon width. Rule normalization/second moment and refinement comparisons checked.
oracle_contract.greeks: Five-point finite differences of the independent Decimal prices for spot and remaining-time derivatives; calendar theta is minus remaining-time derivative. Compared both calls and puts and reconstructed PDE with the independent derivatives.
oracle_contract.cash: High-precision reinvested dividend share counts and bank accrual, independently differentiated target deltas, purchase cash and final liquidation at every date.
oracle_contract.measure: Independent interval log density ratios and integrated tilted normal mass/first/second moments; lambda0 and log-density -1050/544.32 test underflow and representable extremes.
oracle_contract.tolerances: Prices:2e-9 absolute plus1e-10 relative against Decimal; direct payoff quadrature2e-8 absolute plus1e-10 relative; sensitivities2e-8 for delta/gamma and2e-7 for theta; independent PDE residual3e-7; cash4e-8. Normal/optimized same-environment output equality separately checked.

limits: Separate machine-assisted peer audit, not external human certification.
No stochastic theorem is certified by numerical tests; proofs and all exact prompts were read and independently reasoned through.
No current market observation, executed financing or empirical-model claim is verified; whole-edition visual/mobile/print checks remain separate.
